description: My Hot Lunchbox school lunch ordering for Claude — calendar, cart, orders, payments
name: io.github.chrischall/myhotlunchbox-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Email address you sign in to ordernow.myhotlunchbox.com with
environmentVariables.name: MYHOTLUNCHBOX_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Password for that My Hot Lunchbox account
environmentVariables.name: MYHOTLUNCHBOX_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Override the app origin (defaults to https://ordernow.myhotlunchbox.com)
environmentVariables.name: MYHOTLUNCHBOX_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Directory the print tools write PDFs into (defaults to the working directory)
environmentVariables.name: MYHOTLUNCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk token cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.
environmentVariables.name: MYHOTLUNCHBOX_TOKEN_CACHE

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the token cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.myhotlunchbox-mcp/token.json.
environmentVariables.name: MYHOTLUNCHBOX_TOKEN_FILE
